title: Catalog decision flows and version lock wireframes
summary: Notes and wireframe copy for a 'version lock' flow in the model catalog + endpoint creation decision tree. Focus is on making pinning semantics explicit, surface fallback behavior earlier, and reduce accidental stale endpoints.
body:
Purpose
- Capture concrete wireframe descriptions, CTA copy, and grooming notes for a new version-lock UX that lives on the model catalog + endpoint creation path.
- Emphasis: reduce confusion between temporary canary pin and permanent version lock; show fallback behavior proactively so users understand operational guarantees.

Overview of proposed flows
1) Catalog -> Quick Details Drawer
   - Trigger: click model card in catalog grid.
   - Contents: short performance badges (latency/cost/qual), supported shapes, variant count, last-indexed.
   - Primary actions: [Try in Playground] (left), [Create Endpoint] (primary CTA, right), overflow menu: [Compare], [View changelog].
   - New affordance: small lock icon + tooltip near variant count that opens a microcopy popover: "Version lock (stable route): pin a specific model version to an endpoint to avoid silent drift. Supports TTL and automatic fallback."

2) Create Endpoint -> Two high-level paths (wizard entry)
   - Path A: Quick create (default) -> chooses latest compatible variant, default fallback = 1 compatible prior variant, no explicit lock. Microcopy: "Quick create: use sensible defaults for immediate traffic. Change pinning and fallbacks in advanced settings."
   - Path B: Advanced -> crowd into a 3-step wizard: select variant -> pin/lock configuration -> rollout & fallback policy.

Wireframe descriptions (Advanced wizard screens)
Screen 1: Variant selection (grid/list)
- Header: "Choose a model variant to serve"
- Each row: name, short description, measurables (P95 latency, token cost estimate), stability tag (stable/beta/experimental), last-trained.
- Row action: radio select; when selected, show "Compare" checkbox to compare up to 3 variants in an overlay.

Screen 2: Version lock modal (key new UI)
- Title: "Lock a model version (make endpoint stable)"
- Purpose blurb: "Locking pins a specific model artifact to this endpoint. Locked endpoints will not automatically move to newer model versions unless you change the lock or enable an automatic rollout. Locking reduces accidental regressions but may increase maintenance."
- Controls: 
  - Lock type (radio): [Ephemeral pin (canary)] [Permanent lock (version lock)]
  - If Ephemeral pin selected: TTL selector (1h, 1d, 7d, custom) + auto-unpin toggle. Microcopy: "Use ephemeral pins to test a variant with live traffic and automatically revert."
  - If Permanent lock selected: optional description field (string), deprecation-notice checkbox (notify on upstream changes).
  - Fallback policy: dropdown -> [None, Single older compatible variant, All compatible variants], with small inline explanation and consequence icons (green check = graceful, amber clock = higher maintenance, red warn = possible mismatch).
- Help link: "What happens when a locked model is removed from the catalog?" linking to Confluence.
- Primary CTA: [Create endpoint and lock] (primary) Secondary CTA: [Create endpoint without lock]

Screen 3: Rollout & traffic shaping (optional)
- Slider for traffic split (0-100%) if user wants to roll out gradually.
- Canary checkbox appears when slider not at 100% with microcopy: "Start with a canary before committing the lock. Canary TTL auto suggested: 24h."

Microcopy variants (A/B test candidates)
- Version lock explanation (short):
  A: "Pin a model version so your endpoint always uses the same artifact unless you change it. Prevents silent model upgrades."
  B: "Locking freezes the endpoint to one model snapshot. Useful for reproducibility and compliance."
- Quick create helper: "Want fast setup? Choose Quick create and tweak pinning later in endpoint settings."
- Fallback option label: "Graceful fallback" (tooltip: "If primary variant becomes unavailable, route to fallback to avoid outages.")
- CTA copy options: [Create endpoint] vs [Create endpoint & lock] vs [Create stable endpoint]

Error and edge states (copy + wireframe hints)
- If fallback chosen but no compatible variants: show inline error card with suggested actions: "No compat variants found. Enable multi-compat builds or select a different fallback policy." + link to build request flow.
- If creating a permanent lock with an older variant beyond N days (configurable threshold): show warning "This variant is X days old. Consider evaluating performance/regression tests before locking." with buttons [Run smoke evals] [Continue].

Observability hooks shown during creation
- Checkbox: "Enable drift monitoring on this endpoint" (recommended).
- Toggle: "Send lock-change notifications to Slack/email" with channel field.

Backlog grooming notes (priority ordered)
- PROD-512: Embed small lock affordance in catalog cards (front-end + iconography). (owner: Marco)
- UI-623: Implement advanced endpoint creation wizard with version-lock modal. (owner: Asha)
- ENG-1342: Backend API for lock semantics: lock, TTL, fallback policy, deprecation notifications. Need DB schema + audit trail. (owner: Priya)
- QA-208: Create smoke eval harness to run quick perf/regression checks when user attempts a permanent lock.

Open questions / decisions to make
- Should Quick create default to a soft pin (ephemeral TTL 24h) to reduce accidental silent drift? Pros: safety. Cons: hidden complexity.
- What is the default fallback policy for new endpoints? Proposed: single compatible variant.
- Do we allow multi-model fallbacks (i.e., fallback to a compatible model family) or only exact variant matches?
- Notification UX: should lock changes require SSO admin approval for enterprise orgs?

Accessibility notes
- Ensure lock modal is keyboard-first and that fallback policy descriptions are available via aria-describedby.
- Color palette for stability tags must pass contrast checks; use icons as redundant signals.

Prototype and UX experiments
- A/B test microcopy for lock explanation (Variant A vs B above) and two button phrasings: "Create endpoint & lock" vs "Create stable endpoint". Measure conversion + help clicks.
- Track metrics: time-to-create, number of endpoints created with permanent lock, number of automatic reverts from ephemeral pin, support tickets citing accidental drift.

Designer notes for handoff
- Provide 48x48 card icons for lock states: unlocked (outline), ephemeral (clock+lock), permanent (solid lock).
- Motion: small fade+lock scale when user toggles lock; show inline 'toast' confirmation with link to endpoint settings.

Suggested next steps / meeting agenda for sync (30 minutes)
- Walk through wireframes and microcopy variations (10m)
- Agree defaults for Quick create and fallback policy (10m)
- Assign owners for backend API contract + QA smoke pipeline (10m)

Action items
- "Finalize microcopy A/B options and decide on default wording" (owner: Asha)
- "Design icons + final wireframes for modal" (owner: Marco)
- "Draft DB/API schema and audit requirements for locks" (owner: Priya)
- "Create JIRA tickets for QA harness and Confluence how-to" (owner: Riley)

Notes to reviewers
- This doc is intentionally prescriptive in flows to reduce ambiguity in grooming. Please call out any missing failure modes (e.g., model retirements, region-specific variant availability).
- If you prefer the term 'pin' instead of 'lock', note that 'lock' language was chosen to emphasize durability vs ephemeral canary pins.
